description: This source file is a Node.js script used for auditing and analyzing a code repository, specifically parsing TypeScript and JavaScript files to find seams, potential cross-layer interactions, and dependencies. It generates an inventory of seams and related test coverage, with functions to parse, analyze, and produce a report in JSON format.

methods.name: collectWorkspacePackagePaths
methods.description: Collects paths to workspace packages by reading directory entries and appending 'package.json' paths.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Converts absolute file paths to relative project paths with forward slashes.

methods.name: readScannableText
methods.description: Reads a portion of a file up to a maximum byte size for scanning purposes.

methods.name: redactNpmSpec
methods.description: Sanitizes npm specifications strings by removing authentication info.

methods.name: isCodeFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename has a source-code extension (.ts, .js, etc.).

methods.name: isTestLikePath
methods.description: Determines if a relative path points to a test, fixture, or related test-like file.

methods.name: isProductionLikeFile
methods.description: Checks if a relative path points to a production code file, not a test.

methods.name: walkCodeFiles
methods.description: Recursively finds all production code files under a root directory.

methods.name: walkAllCodeFiles
methods.description: Recursively finds all code files, including tests, under a root directory based on options.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Returns the line number for a node in a TypeScript source file.

methods.name: resolveRelativeSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a relative import specifier to an absolute project path.

methods.name: normalizePluginSdkFamily
methods.description: Normalizes a plugin SDK file path to a family identifier.

methods.name: resolveOptionalClusterFromPath
methods.description: Resolves a file path to an optional cluster name if it matches certain prefixes.

methods.name: compareImports
methods.description: Comparator for import entries for sorting.

methods.name: collectPluginSdkImports
methods.description: Collects import/export/dependency info from source files within plugin SDK.

methods.name: collectCorePluginSdkImports
methods.description: Gathers all plugin SDK import info from project source files.

methods.name: collectOptionalClusterStaticImports
methods.description: Collects static imports that reference optional clusters.

methods.name: collectOptionalClusterStaticLeaks
methods.description: Generates an inventory of static cluster references.

methods.name: buildDuplicatedSeamFamilies
methods.description: Groups seam family imports appearing in multiple files.

methods.name: buildOverlapFiles
methods.description: Finds files that involve multiple seam families.

methods.name: buildOptionalClusterStaticLeaks
methods.description: Creates a mapping of optional cluster static dependencies.

methods.name: packageClusterMeta
methods.description: Generates metadata for a package cluster based on its path.

methods.name: classifyMissingPackageCluster
methods.description: Decides if a missing package cluster is required or optional with a reason.

methods.name: buildMissingPackages
methods.description: Analyzes workspace dependencies and flags missing or extraneous dependencies and clusters.

methods.name: stemFromRelativePath
methods.description: Removes extension suffixes from a relative path, extracting a stem for matching.

methods.name: splitNameTokens
methods.description: Splits a name into tokens for heuristic matching.

methods.name: escapeForRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: hasImportSource
methods.description: Checks if source code imports a specific module specifier.

methods.name: hasAnyImportSource
methods.description: Checks if source code imports any of a list of specifiers.

methods.name: matchQualityRank
methods.description: Assigns a numeric rank to different test match qualities for prioritization.

methods.name: findRelatedTests
methods.description: Finds test files related to a source file based on name similarity and import analysis.

methods.name: determineSeamTestStatus
methods.description: Decides whether a seam has no nearby test, partial coverage, or heuristic proximity.

methods.name: buildSeamTestInventory
methods.description: Builds an inventory of seams and their test proximity status across files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that collects data, builds analysis, and outputs JSON report.
